pricing_faq_q1: Yala sɔngɔko bɛ kɛ taama kelen-kelen bɛɛ la wa walima baarakɛlaw sigiyɔrɔ kelen-kelen bɛɛ la?
pricing_faq_a1: Dakun minnu bɔra kɛnɛ kan, olu ye dɔgɔtɔrɔso kulu kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye ni dɔgɔtɔrɔso ni sigilanw ye. Sankaba ni On-premise bɛ Daminɛ, Jago, Scale ani Plateforme tila ɲɔgɔn na. Kalo lisi min bɛ yɔrɔ la, o ye Cloud + $150 ye. Mode fila si tɛ baara kɛ ni mɛtɛrɛ ye min bɛ kɛ siɲɛ kelen-kelen bɛɛ la min bɛ wuli ka taa a fɛ don minnu na mɔgɔw ka ca.
pricing_faq_q2: Mun na san o san bɛ 20% mara?
pricing_faq_a2: San o san fatura bɛ da Soft Wash Medora san dɔ kɔnɔ min bɛ se ka fɔ ka ɲɛ. Loomline-style dɔgɔtɔrɔso SaaS ka teli ka san o san labɛnw dɔgɔya 15 fo 20% ɲɔgɔn. Medora bɛ 20% bɔ kalo o kalo lisi kan n’i bɛ sara san o san, Cloud ni On-premise fila bɛɛ la (+$150 On-premise premium kɔfɛ).
pricing_faq_q3: Yala fɛnmarayɔrɔw ni kɛnɛyaso moduluw bɛ o la wa?
pricing_faq_a3: Starter kɔnɔ, sɛbɛnni kolomaw, taamaw, ani kɛnɛyaso baarakɛyɔrɔw bɛ sɔrɔ ni fɛnmarayɔrɔ jɔnjɔnw ye. Jagokɛlaw ni sanfɛ, u bɛ baara kɛcogo dafalenw da wuli, furaw komandi minnu bɛ tali kɛ stock la, ani admin configuration nafolotigi. Aw ye ɲininkali kɛ waati min na aw mago bɛ farankanw na minnu bɛ labɛn.
pricing_faq_a4: Baara kɛ ni sugu toggle ye min bɛ labɛnw sanfɛ. Duniya bɛɛ bɛ USD dɔrɔn de jira. Myanmar bɛ MMK jira ni 1 USD = 5000 MMK ye (ni USD ye layini filanan ye). Fatura waati ni baarakɛcogo bɛ danfara bɔ sugu la.
pricing_faq_a5: Sankaba bɛ ladon Soft Wash Medora: dɔgɔtɔrɔso caman SaaS, kunnafoni kura ɲɛnabɔlenw, ani daminɛ teliya. On-premise bɛ baara kɛ ni o tiers kelenw ye, minnu bɛ sigi i ka infrastructure kan ni i mago bɛ control walima residency la. Infra ye aw ta ye; kalo o kalo lisi ye Cloud + $150 ye o kunkanbaaraw kama.
